title: Figure 34: Principle of a microcantilever that bends when loaded with an adherent mass
description: Two-part schematic of a cantilever beam clamped to a wall: the upper beam is straight with a green "selective chemical layer" and dimensions L and h, the lower beam bends downward by deflection s as red dots labeled "reacting chemical compound" adhere. Caption reads "Figure 34. Principle of a Microcantilever That Bends When It is Loaded With an Adherent Mass."
